limitations: No higher-dimensional optimal-sampling theorem, noise-regularization guarantee, finite-precision bound, finite-time risk optimum, or independent validation is claimed. Exact previous priority remains subject to further literature comparison.
scientific_integrity: All new claims are restricted to the proved two-coordinate rank-one model, exact arithmetic, fixed stepsizes and independent coordinate draws. The counterexample addresses the general boundedness-to-minimum-norm implication of the motivating paper, not all its special-case theorems. Explicit asymptotic proofs and reproducibility checks are supplied.
title: Exact nullspace-selection risk and a sampling transition for two-column randomized descent
